name: adapt_reverted_fix_typescript_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the agent's bug fix is REVERTED between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, calc.ts rewritten back to the buggy version); the agent must notice and reapply the fix
prompts: calc.ts has a bug in add(a, b) - it currently subtracts instead of adding. Fix it so add(a, b) returns a + b.
Your fix to calc.ts seems to have been reverted - the subtraction bug is back. Please reapply the fix so add(a, b) correctly returns a + b.

disruptions.description: calc.ts reverted back to the buggy (subtraction) version

check_command: tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build calc.ts test_calc.ts && node build/test_calc.js
